subject: Physics
description: Prerequisite concept graph for force, motion, momentum, work and energy.

concepts.name: Velocity
concepts.description: Rate of change of displacement with time, including magnitude and direction.

concepts.name: Speed
concepts.description: Magnitude of velocity; distance travelled per unit time.

concepts.name: Time Interval
concepts.description: Elapsed time between two events.

concepts.name: Displacement
concepts.description: Vector change in position from an initial point to a final point.

concepts.name: Acceleration
concepts.description: Rate of change of velocity with respect to time.

concepts.name: Mass
concepts.description: Physical quantity that measures inertia and appears in the equations of momentum and energy.

concepts.name: Inertia
concepts.description: Property of matter that resists changes in its state of motion.

concepts.name: Force
concepts.description: A push or pull resulting from an interaction between bodies.

concepts.name: Net Force
concepts.description: Vector sum of all external forces acting on a body.

concepts.name: Newton's First Law
concepts.description: An object maintains its state of rest or uniform velocity when the net external force is zero.

concepts.name: Newton's Second Law
concepts.description: The net force on an object equals its mass multiplied by its acceleration.

concepts.name: Newton's Third Law
concepts.description: Interacting bodies exert equal-magnitude and opposite-direction forces on each other.

concepts.name: Friction
concepts.description: Contact force that opposes relative motion or impending motion between surfaces.

concepts.name: Linear Momentum
concepts.description: Product of an object's mass and velocity.

concepts.name: Conservation of Momentum
concepts.description: Total momentum of an isolated system remains constant when the net external force is zero.

concepts.name: Mechanical Work
concepts.description: Energy transferred when a force acts through a displacement.

concepts.name: Kinetic Energy
concepts.description: Energy possessed by an object due to its motion.

concepts.name: Height
concepts.description: Vertical position measured relative to a chosen reference level.

concepts.name: Gravitational Field Strength
concepts.description: Gravitational force per unit mass, commonly represented by g near Earth's surface.

concepts.name: Gravitational Potential Energy
concepts.description: Energy associated with an object's position in a gravitational field, relative to a reference level.

concepts.name: Work-Energy Theorem
concepts.description: Net work done on an object equals its change in kinetic energy.

concepts.name: Conservation of Mechanical Energy
concepts.description: Mechanical energy remains constant in a system when only conservative forces do work.

concepts.name: Mechanical Power
concepts.description: Rate at which work is done or energy is transferred.
